dedupe_keys.name: reseau de transports collectifs de la ccgq

description: Réseau de transports collectifs de la CCGQ is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes du Guillestrois et du Queyras. Theoretical timetables for public transport managed by the Community of communes of Guillestrois and Queyras. The data describe seasonal winter and summer shuttles. They are updated approximately 2 months before the start of seasonal services. Coverage: Communauté de communes du Guillestrois et du Queyras. The portal shows the English title as "The CCGQ's public transportation network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de communes du Guillestrois et du Queyras. Its keywords include mobilite, transport-en-commun, transports-en-commun, mobilites, bus, gtfs. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
